review.description: 454 stable terms: add scoped technical-activity and error-details content elements to the transcript vocabulary; retire the per-command disclosure element while retaining its foundational term. Definitions remain independent of specifications. Added Work status widget and its scoped value term; the 456 definitions remain foundational with no consumer backlinks.
review.implementation: Inspected element-w-item-row-source-link scoped to its existing row widget, plus ui-c-item-source, ui-s-settings and ui-c-open-settings. Definitions describe meaning only; paths, procedures and consumer links stay in UI/flow registries. New stable terms ui-w-work-status and element-w-work-status-value name the compact activity display without importing behavior procedures.
review.tests: Glossary rendering and uniqueness/scope/dependency validation pass with 429 terms. UI uses the four new IDs and keeps dependency direction toward foundations. Full specification tests run through reconciliation; no fixture result is treated as host acceptance. Schema/render checks verify both new IDs, the value naming scope, UI references and duplicate-name boundaries.
